checks.text: Typing 1 in the field labelled "Min" and 10 in the field labelled "Max", then clicking the button "Generate", displays a result in the field labelled "Result" that is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

Typing 2 in the field labelled "Min" and 5 in the field labelled "Max", then clicking the button "Generate", displays a result in the field labelled "Result" that is an integer between 2 and 5 inclusive.
Typing 10 in the field labelled "Min" and 1 in the field labelled "Max", then clicking the button "Generate", displays the error message "Min must be less than Max".
Typing 2d6 in the field labelled "Dice Notation", then clicking the button "Generate", displays a result in the field labelled "Result" that is an integer between 2 and 12 inclusive.
Typing 1d4 in the field labelled "Dice Notation", then clicking the button "Generate", displays a result in the field labelled "Result" that is an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
Typing 1 in the field labelled "Min", 10 in the field labelled "Max", and 5 in the field labelled "Count", then clicking the button "Generate", displays 5 rows in the table labelled "History".
Typing 1 in the field labelled "Min" and 10 in the field labelled "Max", then clicking the button "Generate" twice, displays 2 rows in the table labelled "History".
Typing 1 in the field labelled "Min" and 10 in the field labelled "Max", then clicking the button "Generate", displays a non-empty string in the field labelled "Seed".
Reload keeps the last generated result, so after typing 1 in "Min", 10 in "Max", clicking "Generate", and reloading the page, the field labelled "Result" still contains the same integer value.
